+# What a rescue placement pays for resting on a soft or priority item of
+# another class. The primary search simply excludes such placements
+# (_compatible_support); every rescue rung and the rollout's fallback run
+# with relax=True, which used to admit them at no cost at all -- so among
+# the placements a rescue could make, one that buries a soft or priority
+# bag ranked the same as one that does not. Now it ranks lower (heavier
+# loads more so: they are what crushes), so the rescue still finds exactly
+# the same set of placements but prefers the compliant ones.
+RELAX_VIOLATION_PENALTY = 200.0
+RELAX_VIOLATION_PER_KG = 20.0
+
+
+# Burying soft / priority items. The placement and soft scores penalise a
+# priority (soft) item with an item of another class above it; the primary
+# search already refuses to REST a plain item on one (_compatible_support),
+# but an item anywhere higher up in the same column still counts. The
+# public solver's published scores fit that reading: its production
+# placement / soft / stability, each divided by its local value, all come
+# to 0.77-0.79 when placement / soft are scored by column, not contact.
+# On 128 scenes the primary search made 377 of the 478 soft column pairs
+# (tools/viol_trace.py). So a candidate that would newly bury a soft or
+# priority item -- one nothing of another class covers yet -- pays W_BURY
+# per such item; an item already buried costs nothing more, since the
+# score counts each buried item once.
+#
+# Measured on 128 scenes against hotfix2: 150 cut soft items buried (column
+# rule) 227 -> 163, soft +1.29 (se 0.58), placement +0.91 (se 0.72), for
+# items -0.30 (se 0.30) and fill -0.29 (se 0.28); equal-weight five-score
+# mean +0.37 (se 0.18, p=0.024). 400 was worse on every count (fill -0.59).
+# Priority items barely move (69 -> 67): half their burials are k=1 scenes,
+# where a mid-stream priority bag is covered by whatever comes after it.
+W_BURY = 150.0
+BURY_TOL = 0.02         # same as the scorer: covered if bottom >= top - this
+
+
+def _exposed_protected(cstate, item_spec):
+    """(cx, cy, hx, hy, top) of every soft / priority box that the item
+    would bury (it is of another class) and that is not buried yet."""
+    soft_item = bool(item_spec.get('is_soft'))
+    prio_item = bool(item_spec.get('is_prioritized'))
+    boxes = cstate.boxes
+    out = []
+    for b in boxes:
+        want_soft = b['is_soft'] and not soft_item
+        want_prio = b['is_prioritized'] and not prio_item
+        if not (want_soft or want_prio):
+            continue
+        (bx, by, bz), (bhx, bhy, bhz) = b['center'], b['half']
+        top = bz + bhz
+        soft_cov = prio_cov = False
+        for o in boxes:
+            if o is b:
+                continue
+            if o['center'][2] - o['half'][2] < top - BURY_TOL:
+                continue
+            if (abs(o['center'][0] - bx) >= o['half'][0] + bhx
+                    or abs(o['center'][1] - by) >= o['half'][1] + bhy):
+                continue
+            if b['is_soft'] and not o['is_soft']:
+                soft_cov = True
+            if b['is_prioritized'] and not o['is_prioritized']:
+                prio_cov = True
+        n = (1 if want_soft and not soft_cov else 0) + (1 if want_prio and not prio_cov else 0)
+        if n:
+            out.append((bx, by, bhx, bhy, top, n))
+    return out
+
+
+def _bury_count(exposed, cx, cy, hx, hy, bottom):
+    n = 0
+    for (bx, by, bhx, bhy, top, k) in exposed:
+        if (bottom >= top - BURY_TOL and abs(cx - bx) < hx + bhx and abs(cy - by) < hy + bhy):
+            n += k
+    return n

+# --- Rescue search (plan v3, Phase C) ---------------------------------------
+#
+# What runs when the primary search places nothing. It used to be four full
+# choose_action passes, one per support rule, all sharing one deadline: the
+# ~1.5 s left went on re-scoring the largest items (which the primary search
+# had just failed with) under the strictest rule, and on k>=5 pools the
+# looser rules were almost never reached. Replaying the moment each of 54
+# stuck one-container scenes ended and giving that one decision unlimited
+# time placed another item in 24 of them (+0.50 items per stuck scene,
+# tools/term_fork.py) -- but it took a median 9.9 s of search.
+#
+# Same decision rule, organised so the time goes where rescues come from:
+#   * items smallest first (smallest dimension, then volume): in a jammed
+#     container the small ones are what still fit,
+#   * each item's candidate lists are enumerated once and reused by every
+#     support rule, and whether a box clears walls and the insertion path is
+#     decided once (vcache) -- only the cheap support test differs per rule,
+#   * identical items are evaluated once.
+# The result is still "the strictest rule under which anything fits, then
+# the best score under that rule", exactly what the rung-by-rung ladder
+# returned whenever it had the time to finish.

+def rescue_placement(cstate, item_spec, time_deadline, ladder, max_level):
+    """(level, pos, orn, score) for the strictest rule in ladder[:max_level]
+    under which this item fits in this container, or None."""

+        for step in (None, 0.05, 0.025):
+            if time_deadline is not None and time.perf_counter() > time_deadline:
+                return None
+            cands = stage_cands.get(step)
+            if cands is None:
+                if step is None:
+                    xy_fn = _xy_candidates
+                else:
+                    def xy_fn(cs, fx, fy, walls, hz, _s=step):
+                        return _grid_xy(cs, fx, fy, _s, walls)
+                cands = _collect(cstate, item_spec, True, xy_fn, time_deadline)
+                if time_deadline is not None and time.perf_counter() > time_deadline:
+                    return None          # may be a truncated enumeration
+                stage_cands[step] = cands
+            r = _first_valid(cstate, cands, time_deadline, rule['require_support'], None,
+                             rule['min_cover'], rule['require_centroid'], None, vcache)
+            if r is not None:

+def rescue_action(container_states, pool, time_deadline, ladder, min_call=None):
+    """Returns (pool_idx, container_idx, pos_local, orn_idx) or None: the
+    placement under the strictest rule of `ladder` that anything fits
+    under, best-scoring (as choose_action scores) within that rule."""
+    if min_call is None:
+        min_call = RESCUE_MIN_CALL
+    any_priority_container = any(cs.geom['is_prioritized'] for cs in container_states.values())
+
+    def small_first(t):
+        s = t[1]
+        return (min(s['length'], s['width'], s['height']),
+                s['length'] * s['width'] * s['height'])
+    items = _unique_specs(sorted(pool, key=small_first))
+    n_calls = max(len(items) * len(container_states), 1)
+    best = None
+    best_key = None
+    done = 0
+    for pool_idx, spec in items:
+        for cidx, cstate in container_states.items():
+            now = time.perf_counter()
+            left = n_calls - done
+            done += 1
+            if now > time_deadline:
+                continue
+            per_call = max((time_deadline - now) / max(left, 1), min_call)
+            # Never look at a rule looser than the best already found.
+            max_level = best_key[0] + 1 if best_key is not None else len(ladder)
+            r = rescue_placement(cstate, spec, min(time_deadline, now + per_call),
+                                 ladder, max_level)
+            if r is None:
+                continue
+            level, pos, orn, score = r
+            score = _action_score(spec, cstate.geom, any_priority_container, score)
+            key = (level, -score)
+            if best_key is None or key < best_key:
+                best_key = key
+                best = (pool_idx, cidx, pos, orn)
+    return best
